title: Sample Rate
body:
Sample rate is the number of samples taken per second taken from a *continuous* sample
to turn it into a *discrete* sample.

The theory is [[Sampling Theorem]] in [[FOURIER AND COMPLEX ANALYSIS]]: sample faster than **twice**
the highest frequency present and nothing is lost at all; slower and high frequencies fold down onto
low ones irreversibly, which is [[Aliasing]].
